verses.1: For those who are to be destroyed, there is testimony from Asaf Mizmor.
verses.2: Look, Israel! Listen carefully. It’s like a lamb that is led to the slaughter. The horns are ready to be used for its destruction.
verses.3: Before Ephraim and Benjamin, and Manasseh, they plotted to destroy your glory. Let them be destroyed!
verses.4: God has brought us back, and He has illuminated your face. We will be saved.
verses.5: Yehova, God of hosts, you who have created everything until now, you have done this through the prayers of your people.
verses.6: They ate bread that was bitter, and their mouths became sore from the bitterness.
verses.7: Let us treat our neighbors with kindness, and let our enemies be mocked.
verses.8: God, your armies, have brought us back. May your face be illuminated, and may we be saved.
verses.9: The fruit from Egypt will drive away nations, and it will be planted there.
verses.10: I went before her, and she planted her roots in the earth. Then she filled the land with life.
verses.11: Its mountains were covered with clouds, and its branches were like the branches of an olive tree.
verses.12: Send her harvests to the sea and to the rivers where they will be watered.
verses.13: Why did you spread out its gardens and make them full of flowers along all the paths?
verses.14: May the pig from the forest be destroyed, and may its fields be ruined.
verses.15: God of hosts, please come down from heaven once more. Let there be seen what is happening in this garden.
verses.16: And the vineyard that you planted on your right side… You also planted it for yourself.
verses.17: Flames consume everything, as a result of your anger. Everything will be destroyed.
verses.18: May your hand be on your right hand, and may your right hand be upon the son of man.
verses.19: And no one will be saved from me; our lives will be lost. And in your name, we will be called upon.
verses.20: YHWH, God of hosts, restore us to your face, and we shall be saved.
